explication: Claude Code Telegram Bot provides conversational and classic-mode access to project work, with per-user/project session continuity. Telegram updates enter the orchestrator and reach Claude for agentic responses; classic commands add project navigation and feature actions. A parallel automation path accepts webhooks and scheduled triggers through a typed event bus, with notifications delivering results. SQLite supports sessions, usage and automation state, while configuration and security checks constrain operation. The README documents feature breadth; unsampled modules and runtime wiring are represented only where tree/index or README evidence supports them.
